display_long_description:
You're an egg. You have a bazooka. This is going to get weird. 🥚💥

EGGSCAPE is a free multiplayer VR shooter and platformer on Meta Quest. Physics-based chaos, shell-slide racing, and a level editor deep enough to break.

🥚  BE AN EGG
Small. Unstable. Every round is different. No two eggs cook the same.

🔫  SHOOT EVERYTHING
Bazookas, grenades, magic powerups, vehicles, and an arsenal of silly weapons. Fresh items drop with every update.

🏗️  BUILD YOUR OWN LEVELS
A full level editor with logic and triggers. Make maps. Share maps. Play maps. The community keeps inventing things nobody saw coming.

🤖  FIGHT EVIL ROBOTS
They don't like eggs. You don't like them. Everyone's happy.

🎖️  UNLOCK COSMETICS
Skins, weapon camos, trails, and emotes in the Battle Pass. New drops every season.

🎮  PLAYS ON EVERY META QUEST
Runs on Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S, and Pro. Free to play. No paywalls on gameplay.

So are you gonna play or what?

LISTEN: BE AN EGG.
BE AN EGG NOW.
BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE.
